audience: membership organizations and clubs that manage members and events in Wild Apricot

useCases.title: Find a member and their membership level
useCases.text: The AI searches contacts by name, email or phone, or by a filter like active membership status. It opens one record with fields, level and status.

useCases.title: See upcoming events and who registered
useCases.text: The AI lists events, such as upcoming ones with registration open, and the attendee list of an event with fee, paid, checked in and waitlist.

useCases.title: Find unpaid invoices and recent payments
useCases.text: The AI lists unpaid invoices, also for one contact or event, and payments received in a date range. It adds up what is still outstanding.

useCases.title: Review recent admin and member activity
useCases.text: The AI lists audit log items such as membership changes, payments and invoices in a date range, and summarizes what happened.

useCases.title: Add or update a member and register them for an event
useCases.text: The AI creates a contact or member, or updates their details and level, and registers a contact for an event under a registration type.

useCases.title: Check attendees in at an event
useCases.text: The AI marks an event registration as checked in, or undoes it. For anonymous guests it sets how many are checked in.
